subject: heat-transfer

sourceIssues.issue: With positive uniform generation, an interior maximum above the hotter 100°C face is not guaranteed unless the generation is sufficiently large. Therefore the stated data do not imply any listed option.
sourceIssues.referenceAnswer: T(x) = 100x/L + (g/(2k))x(L−x). The maximum exceeds 100°C only when gL²/(2k) > 100°C. Do not use the book’s unconditional B choice as an automatic key.
